name: Chronology builder
description: Reads the matter's documents in order, records every dated event in the matter memory, and drafts a cited chronology memo for approval.
goal_hint: e.g. Build a chronology of the dispute from the agreement, the notices and the orders.
instructions: Build a chronology of the matter. List the documents, read each relevant one in order, and record every dated event with remember_fact (kind "event", event_date as YYYY-MM-DD, the passage id as source). Then draft an internal memo with create_draft listing the events in date order, one per line, each cited. Finish with a short summary of the key dates and any gaps.
